sourceText: User asked why B-90d6 reached DONE without package.json version bump/release and then requested to fix the mechanism together, including self-repair in this side conversation.
normalizedOutcome: DONE/recovery paths that change Proofbound CLI runtime behavior cannot silently finish without a local package patch bump, and the bump keeps package.json, lockfiles, source brand, dist brand, and CLI version synchronized without remote push or publish.
acceptanceClaim: A runtime-changing done_recover fixture auto-bumps before build, version-bump smoke proves five-point package and lockfile synchronization with drift/rollback guards, and the story can only complete when the final local version boundary is aligned beyond 0.3.170.
